why: An Internal-class title earns first-match credit only, never the accumulation bonus (operator, 2026-10-02, accepting BMR-Review's measurement in HANDOFF-FROM-BMR-REVIEW-2026-10-02-internal-title-measured-one-mechanism-change). Shaped on a human-labelled NO MATCH: the real titles agree at about 0.96 ('Weisss Blut' / 'Weisses Blut'), and once they are aligned the candidate's Internal translation 'White blood' is left pairing with the submission's French subtitle at a fraction of its discount. As 0.40.0 shipped, nonlinear.accumulate added that weak pair as a bonus and the title rose from 0.957 to 1.153, which auto-matched the labelled no-match. With the bonus restricted to real pairs the title stays at the real pair's value. Pending because it pins the knob-PRESENT path: with INTERNAL_TITLE_DISCOUNT absent the Internal title is not compared at all and the fixture passes for the wrong reason, so it lands with the compare-spec version that adds the knob. Invariants are value-independent: the title is carried by the real pair (at least 0.9) and gains nothing from the translation (at most 1.0). SCOPE: Basic, one Internal title on the candidate side, a second real submitted title that the translation can only weakly align with; it does not pin the discount's value.
